1.explanation: The 'Item' class in 'src/menu/view/item.jsx' is directly responsible for rendering the Menu Item, including the title attribute. Modifications to this class are necessary to implement the proposed solutions, such as changing the title to an aria-label or conditionally rendering the title based on the content type. This class is central to the bug as it handles the display logic for Menu Items, which is where the redundancy issue arises.
1.bug_scenario: The current implementation of the Menu Item includes a title attribute that is automatically set, which can lead to redundancy when the title is the same as the inner text. This violates accessibility guidelines and causes issues for some users who do not want the title tooltip to appear. The proposed solutions involve changing the title to an aria-label or providing a configuration option to control the title display.
